definition_zh: 文本；正文；课文；文字材料；发短信
definition_en: the written words of a book or document as opposed to pictures or notes, or to send someone a written message on a phone
core_image: 一张纸上一行行真正的字：不是边角的批注，而是正文本身
scene: 课堂上老师让大家先看图再看字。Read the text on page ten before answering the questions.
sceneCN: 这里 text 是「课文；正文」（第 1 个义项：书页上与图片、注释相对的正文文字）；句意：答题前先读第十页的课文。

derivatives.zh: 文本的；正文的（text 加形容词后缀 -ual 构成）
质地；纹理（同出拉丁 texere「编织」，指织出来的手感）
上下文；语境（con- 加 texere 词根，指与正文织在一起的周边文字）
教科书（text 与 book 复合）

senses.title: The main written words
senses.definition: the actual words of a book, article or document, as opposed to pictures, tables or notes
senses.definitionCN: 书、文章或文件的正文文字，与图片、表格或注释相对
senses.example: Look at the picture first, then read the text beside it.
senses.exampleCN: 先看图，再读旁边的正文。
senses.why: The word separates what is woven from what is added: the main cloth of words against the trimmings.
senses.whyCN: 这个词把「织出来的」与「附加的」分开：正文的字布相对于边角装饰。

senses.title: A written work studied as literature
senses.definition: a written work treated as an object of study, especially in literary or religious criticism
senses.definitionCN: 被当作研究对象的书，尤用于文学或宗教批评
senses.example: Students compare two ancient texts of the same poem.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们比较同一首诗的两个古文本。
senses.why: Once words are fixed in writing, the fixed thing itself can be handled, compared and argued over as a text.
senses.whyCN: 文字一经写定，写定的东西本身就可被当作文本摆弄、比较、争论。

senses.title: A message on a phone
senses.definition: a written message sent by mobile phone
senses.definitionCN: 用手机发送的书面讯息
senses.example: I got a text from her an hour ago.
senses.exampleCN: 一小时前我收到了她的短信。
senses.why: The smallest modern text: written words stripped down to fit a screen and a thumb.
senses.whyCN: 最小的现代「文本」：被屏幕和拇指削到极简的书面语。

senses.title: To send a text message
senses.definition: to send someone a written message using a mobile phone
senses.definitionCN: 用手机给某人发书面讯息
senses.example: Text me when you arrive at the station.
senses.exampleCN: 到车站后给我发短信。
senses.why: The noun moves into verb position the way English loves: the message names the act of sending it.
senses.whyCN: 名词顺势转成动词：讯息之名加给了发送的动作。

senses.title: A passage quoted or used as basis
senses.definition: a short passage from a book, especially one chosen as the subject of a talk or sermon
senses.definitionCN: 书中的短段文字，尤指被选作演讲或布道主题者
senses.example: The priest chose a text from John's gospel for the sermon.
senses.exampleCN: 牧师从约翰福音里选了段经文作讲道底本。
senses.why: A chosen passage stands alone as the base the speaker weaves the talk around.
senses.whyCN: 被选出的段落独立出来，成为讲话者围绕编织的底本。

intro.en: Text is woven: Latin texere meant to weave, and textus was the fabric of a discourse, the thing woven out of words. The weaving image survives in texture and context too.
intro.cn: text 是「织」出来的：拉丁语 texere 意为编织，textus 是话语织成的布料。织的意象同样活在 texture 与 context 里。

items.en: Texere meant to weave, and textus named the woven thing, later the tissue of a written argument.
items.cn: texere 意为编织，textus 指织成之物，后指写成的论证之「织体」。

items.en: The same root gives texture, the feel of weave, and context, the words woven together with a passage.
items.cn: 同一词根给出 texture（织物的手感）与 context（与段落织在一起的前后文字）。

items.en: Old French texte carried the Latin word in the sense of the authoritative wording of scripture.
items.cn: 古法语 texte 承接拉丁词，指圣经经文的权威字句。

items.en: English took text in the 14th century, first for the scriptural passage behind a sermon, then for any body of writing.
items.cn: 英语于十四世纪借入 text，先指布道所依的经文段，后泛指一切书面文字。

items.en: Printing, criticism and finally the mobile phone extended the word to any written matter and to texting.
items.cn: 印刷、文学批评，最后是手机，把这个词扩展到一切书面材料与「发短信」。

note.en: The first group collects the weaving family that text belongs to; the second separates text from neighbouring writing words.
note.cn: 第一组收拢 text 所属的「编织」词族；第二组把 text 与相邻的书写类词分开。

entries.definition: the feel and pattern of a surface, from Latin texere to weave; same weaving root, different sense path
entries.definitionCN: 质地；纹理；同出 texere「编织」词根但义路不同

entries.definition: the words woven around a passage; con- means together and the rest is the weaving root
entries.definitionCN: 上下文；语境；con- 表「共同」，词干即「织」

entries.definition: a false reason woven in front of an action; pre- means before
entries.definitionCN: 借口；托辞；pre- 表「在前」，把假理由「织」在行动之前

entries.definition: a section of writing; shorter than a text and without the idea of the whole work
entries.definitionCN: 段落；指作品中的一部分，不指整部著作

entries.definition: sacred writing; text once meant almost exactly this in English
entries.definitionCN: 经文；text 早期的含义几乎就是它

entries.definition: the exact choice of words; narrower than text, which names the whole written body
entries.definitionCN: 措辞；比 text 窄，text 指整篇书面文字

normalIntro.en: Real links: the weaving root texere, the family of texture and context, the sermon text, and the modern text message.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：编织词根 texere、texture 与 context 词族、布道经文、以及现代短信。

normal.en: Text comes from weaving: words woven line by line like thread.
normal.cn: text 来自编织：文字像线一样一行行织出。

normal.en: Texture is what weaving feels like; context is what is woven with it.
normal.cn: texture 是织物的手感；context 是与它织在一起的东西。

normal.en: A preacher once spoke from a chosen text; now a teenager speaks by texting.
normal.cn: 牧师曾依选定的经文讲道；如今少年靠发短信说话。

normal.en: Pretext: a reason woven in front to cover the real one.
normal.cn: pretext：织在前面的理由，盖住真理由。

normal.en: Textbook: the book that holds the set texts for study.
normal.cn: textbook：装着指定课文的教材。

abstract.en: Every text is cloth: threads of words, woven tight enough to carry meaning.
abstract.cn: 每篇文本都是布：文字作线，织得够紧才承得住意义。

abstract.en: Cut a sentence from its context and the weave frays.
abstract.cn: 把句子从语境中剪出来，布就散线。

abstract.en: A text message is a woven ribbon only ten centimetres long.
abstract.cn: 短信只是一条十厘米长的织带。

examples.en: The printed text differs slightly from the manuscript.
examples.cn: 印本正文与手稿略有出入。

examples.en: She texted her mother as soon as the plane landed.
examples.cn: 飞机一落地她就给妈妈发了短信。

examples.en: Scholars still argue about the original text of the play.
examples.cn: 学者们仍在争论这部剧本的原文。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「贴克斯特」——把课文一段段贴在课桌上克敌制胜，先贴先读 → text 文本、课文

root: 拉丁语 texere「编织」→ textus「织成之物、话语织体」→ 古法语 texte → 英语；同根词 texture、context、pretext。

sensesIntro.en: Text starts as the woven body of words against its trimmings, becomes an object of study, shrinks into a phone message, turns into a verb, and can still name the single passage a sermon is built on.
sensesIntro.cn: text 从与装饰相对的「文字织体」出发，成为研究对象，缩成手机短信，转为动词，也仍可指布道所依的单一经段。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: words woven line by line into cloth.
core.cn: 核心意象：文字如线，一行行织成布。

branches.en: The main cloth of words against pictures and notes.
branches.cn: 相对于图片与注释的文字主布。

branches.en: The fixed cloth becomes an object to study and compare.
branches.cn: 写定的织体成为可研究比较的对象。

branches.en: The message shrinks the cloth to a ribbon, then names the sending.
branches.cn: 短信把布缩成细带，进而命名发送动作。

branches.en: One thread cut out becomes the base of a sermon.
branches.cn: 剪出的一根线成为布道的底本。

branches.en: Weaving and studying share the same cloth.
branches.cn: 编织与研究共享同一块布。

intro.en: The weaving root texere/tec- builds a wide family: text, texture, context, pretext, textile, and even technology through Greek craft-words.
intro.cn: 编织词根 texere/tec- 构建了庞大词族：text、texture、context、pretext、textile，甚至经希腊工匠词进入 technology。

latinIntro.en: Latin texere and textus sit under the whole family; the root also gave textor, a weaver, and textura, the structure of weaving.
latinIntro.cn: 整个词族建立在拉丁 texere 与 textus 之上；词根还给出 textor「织工」与 textura「织构」。

items.example: A textual error crept into the reprint.
items.exampleCN: 重印本混入了一处文字错误。

items.example: Guess the meaning from context.
items.exampleCN: 从上下文猜词义。

items.example: He left early on the pretext of illness.
items.exampleCN: 他借口生病提前离开。

items.meaning: the feel or structure of a surface
items.example: The fabric has a rough texture.
items.exampleCN: 这布料手感粗糙。

items.meaning: a woven fabric; relating to weaving
items.example: The city is a textile centre.
items.exampleCN: 这座城市是纺织业中心。

items.example: Buy the textbook before class.

items.meaning: the meaning woven beneath the words
items.example: The subtext of the letter was anger.
items.exampleCN: 这封信的潜台词是愤怒。

items.example: He texted twice last night.
items.exampleCN: 他昨晚发了两次短信。

items.meaning: the habit of sending phone messages
items.example: Texting while driving is dangerous.
items.exampleCN: 开车发短信很危险。

definition_zh: 感谢；谢意；多亏
definition_en: to tell someone that you are grateful for something they have done
core_image: 接过别人递来的东西，低头说一声谢
scene: 老人接过水杯，向学生点头致谢。The old man took the cup and thanked the student with a nod.
sceneCN: 这里 thank 是「感谢」（第 1 个义项：向人表达谢意）；句意：老人接过水杯，向学生点头表示感谢。

derivatives.zh: thank 加 -ful 构成，义为「感激的」
thank 加 -less 构成，义为「得不到感谢的；不值得感激的」
thank 的复数名词化，义为「谢意」

senses.title: To tell someone you are grateful
senses.definition: to say that you are grateful to someone for something they gave or did
senses.definitionCN: 就别人给予或所做之事向对方表示感激
senses.example: She thanked the driver for waiting.
senses.exampleCN: 她感谢司机等她。
senses.why: The Old English noun behind the verb means thought or good will, so thanking is giving someone the thought that they were kind.
senses.whyCN: 动词背后的古英语名词意为「想法、善意」，所以道谢就是把「你很好心」这个念头说给对方。

senses.title: Words or feelings of gratitude
senses.definition: an expression of gratitude, usually in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 感激的表达，通常用复数形式
senses.example: She sent her thanks to the whole team.
senses.exampleCN: 她向整个团队表达了谢意。
senses.why: The verb's plural form works as a noun, naming the spoken or written thanks themselves.
senses.whyCN: 动词的复数形式被拿来当名词用，指的就是说出口或写下来的那些感谢话。

senses.title: Because of, as a result of
senses.definition: used in the phrase thanks to to say that something good happened because of a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 用于 thanks to 这一说法，表示好事因某人或某物而发生
senses.example: Thanks to the early rain, the garden looks green again.
senses.exampleCN: 多亏了那场早雨，花园又绿了起来。
senses.why: If someone caused a good result, gratitude is owed to them, and the phrase turns that debt into a cause.
senses.whyCN: 如果某件事带来了好结果，感激就落到促成它的人身上，短语便把这份亏欠转成「多亏、归功于」。

intro.en: Thank comes from Old English thancian, related to the noun thanc, thought or gratitude.
intro.cn: thank 来自古英语 thancian，与名词 thanc（想法、感激）相关。

items.en: Thanc means thought, good will, or gratitude.
items.cn: thanc 意为想法、善意或感激。

items.en: Thancian is the verb meaning to give thanks or to be grateful.
items.cn: thancian 是表示致谢、心怀感激的动词。

items.en: The verb becomes thank, and the plural thanks becomes a noun for gratitude.
items.cn: 中古英语中动词演变为 thank，复数 thanks 成为表示谢意的名词。

items.en: Thank you settles as the fixed polite formula.
items.cn: thank you 固定为礼貌用语。

items.en: Thanks to develops the sense of owing a good result to someone.
items.cn: thanks to 发展出「把好结果归功于某人」的含义。

note.en: Thank has a small native family, and it stands beside the vocabulary of gratitude.
note.cn: thank 有一个小的本土词族，并与表示感激的词汇相邻。

normalIntro.cn: thank 与表示「想法」的古词相连，感激最初就是把对方放在心上。

normal.en: The old noun meant thought or good will, so thanks is good will spoken aloud.
normal.cn: 古名词意为想法或善意，所以道谢就是把善意说出来。

normal.en: Add -ful for thankful and -less for thankless.
normal.cn: 加 -ful 得 thankful，加 -less 得 thankless。

normal.en: The plural thanks works as a noun, as in many thanks.
normal.cn: 复数 thanks 作名词用，如 many thanks。

normal.en: Thank someone for something, not to something.
normal.cn: 句型是 thank someone for something，介词用 for。

normal.en: Thanks to introduces a cause, and it usually points to a good one.
normal.cn: thanks to 引出原因，通常指好的原因。

abstract.en: Picture both hands taking a cup and a small bow of the head.
abstract.cn: 想象双手接过杯子，同时轻轻低头。

abstract.en: See a card with two short lines written on it.
abstract.cn: 想象一张写着两行短句的卡片。

abstract.en: Think of a warm nod exchanged at a doorway.
abstract.cn: 想门口互相点头致意的那一刻。

examples.en: I thanked her for helping with the boxes.
examples.cn: 我感谢她帮忙搬箱子。

examples.en: Many thanks for your kind reply.
examples.cn: 非常感谢您的亲切回复。

examples.en: Thanks to the new road, the trip takes half the time.
examples.cn: 多亏了这条新路，行程时间缩短了一半。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「三克」——想象收到三克重的小礼物也要认真道谢；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 thancian，与名词 thanc（想法、善意、感激）同源。

sensesIntro.en: Holding someone in grateful thought becomes the verb, the plural noun, and the phrase that credits a cause.
sensesIntro.cn: 把对方放在感激的念头里，长成动词、复数名词，以及把结果归功于某方的短语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small bow while receiving something.
core.cn: 核心意象：接过东西时轻轻低头。

branches.en: The verb speaks the good will out loud.
branches.cn: 动词义把这份善意说出口。

branches.en: The plural noun names the words themselves.
branches.cn: 复数名词指这些话语本身。

branches.en: Gratitude turns into credit when a good result is traced to someone.
branches.cn: 当好结果被追溯到某人身上，感激就变成归功。

branches.en: Saying thanks and the thanks said are the same act.
branches.cn: 道谢与所说的谢意是同一个行为。

branches.en: Both keep the idea of a debt of good will.
branches.cn: 两者都保留了「善意之债」的观念。

intro.en: Thank is a native stem that takes familiar English endings rather than Latin ones.
intro.cn: thank 是本土词干，接的是常见英语词尾，而不是拉丁词尾。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin element in thank; its relatives come from Old English.
latinIntro.cn: thank 没有拉丁成分，其同族词来自古英语。

items.example: The stem thank carries the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 词干 thank 承载整个词族。

items.example: Thanks works as a plural noun.
items.exampleCN: thanks 作复数名词使用。

items.meaningCN: 过去式或过去分词词尾
items.example: Thanked marks the past tense.
items.exampleCN: thanked 标记过去式。

items.example: Thanking is the present participle.
items.exampleCN: thanking 是现在分词。

items.example: Thankful means full of gratitude.
items.exampleCN: thankful 意为「满怀感激的」。

items.example: Thankless means receiving no thanks.
items.exampleCN: thankless 意为「得不到感谢的」。

items.example: Thanc is the noun behind the verb.
items.exampleCN: thanc 是动词背后的名词。

items.example: Thancian is the Old English ancestor of thank.
items.exampleCN: thancian 是 thank 的古英语祖先。

derivatives.zh: 谢意；感谢
感激的
得不到感谢的

definition_zh: 这；那（定冠词，特指已知的人或物）
definition_en: used before a noun that the listener can identify, or before something unique
core_image: 手指稳稳地点在已经认得的那件东西上
scene: 她进门后把钥匙放在架子上，顺手关掉了灯。She came in, put the key on a shelf, and turned off a lamp.
sceneCN: 这里 the 是「这个」（第 1 个义项：特指双方已知的事物）；句意：她进门后把钥匙放在架子上，顺手关掉了灯。

derivatives.zh: 与 the 同出古英语指示词干，义为「这个」
与 the 同出古英语指示词干，义为「那个」
与 the 同出指示词干，义为「那里」

senses.title: A thing already known
senses.definition: used before a noun that the listener can identify from the situation or from what was already said
senses.definitionCN: 用在听者能从情境或前文辨认出的名词前
senses.example: The book on the desk is mine.
senses.exampleCN: 桌上的那本书是我的。
senses.why: The speaker and listener already share which thing is meant, so the article points rather than introduces.
senses.whyCN: 说话人和听者已经知道指的是哪一样，于是这个冠词是在指认而不是介绍。

senses.title: Something unique
senses.definition: used before a noun that is unique in the situation, such as the sun or the sky
senses.definitionCN: 用在情境中唯一的事物前，如太阳、天空
senses.example: The sun rose behind the hills.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳从山后升起。
senses.why: If only one such thing exists in view, the article simply marks that uniqueness.
senses.whyCN: 如果视野中只有一样这样的东西，冠词只是标出它的唯一性。

senses.title: A whole class of people
senses.definition: used before an adjective to name a whole class of people
senses.definitionCN: 用在形容词前，指一整类人
senses.example: The rich should help the poor.
senses.exampleCN: 富人应该帮助穷人。
senses.why: One adjective after the article stands for every member of a class, so the phrase means the whole group.
senses.whyCN: 冠词后的一个形容词代表一类中的每个成员，于是这个短语指整个群体。

senses.title: The highest or a particular rank
senses.definition: used before superlatives and ordinal words to mark the highest or a particular rank
senses.definitionCN: 用在最高级和序数词前，标记最高或特定次序
senses.example: This is the best tea in town.
senses.exampleCN: 这是城里最好的茶。
senses.why: A highest rank is unique by definition, so the definite article naturally accompanies it.
senses.whyCN: 最高等级按定义就是唯一的，所以定冠词自然与它同行。

intro.en: The began as a set of demonstratives meaning that, and it slowly became the one definite article.
intro.cn: the 起初是一组意为「那个」的指示词，后来慢慢变成唯一的定冠词。

items.en: Se, seo and thaet are demonstratives that agree with gender and case.
items.cn: se、seo、thaet 是随性与格变化的指示词。

items.en: One form, the, replaces the whole set before nouns.
items.cn: 中古英语中，一个形式 the 取代了整套变格形式。

items.en: The plus an adjective comes to name a whole class.
items.cn: the 加形容词开始指称一整类人。

items.en: The is fixed as the definite article in standard English.
items.cn: 近代早期，the 在标准英语中固定为定冠词。

items.en: The also appears in comparative phrases such as the more the better.
items.cn: 现代英语中，the 还出现在 the more the better 一类比较结构里。

note.en: The points to what is known, while a and some leave the identity open.
note.cn: the 指向已知的事物，而 a 与 some 让身份保持开放。

entries.definition: the thing near the speaker
the thing farther from the speaker
the plural of this
one thing not yet identified
entries.definitionCN: 不定冠词，指尚未指明的一样东西

entries.definition: an unspecified amount
one or some, without restriction

normalIntro.en: The is a pointing word that assumes the listener already knows the target.
normalIntro.cn: the 是一个指认词，默认听者已经知道所指。

normal.en: Say the book when both people know which book.
normal.cn: 双方都知道是哪本书时，说 the book。

normal.en: The sun is unique, so it always takes the.
normal.cn: 太阳是唯一的，所以总用 the。

normal.en: The rich means rich people as a class.
normal.cn: the rich 指作为一类人的富人。

normal.en: Superlatives take the because the top is one.
normal.cn: 最高级前用 the，因为顶点只有一个。

normal.en: The more the better repeats the for a ratio.
normal.cn: the more the better 用两个 the 表示比例。

abstract.en: Picture a finger resting on one known object.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指停在一件已知的东西上。

abstract.en: See a spotlight aimed at a single spot on a stage.
abstract.cn: 想象聚光灯只打在舞台的一点上。

abstract.en: Think of a box already ticked on a list.
abstract.cn: 想象清单上一个已经打勾的方框。

examples.en: The book on the desk is mine.
examples.cn: 桌上的那本书是我的。

examples.en: The sun rose behind the hills.
examples.cn: 太阳从山后升起。

examples.en: This is the best tea in town.
examples.cn: 这是城里最好的茶。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「这」——the 与「这」同义，都指向眼前已知的东西；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语指示词 se、seo、thaet 的弱化合并形式。

sensesIntro.en: One article marks what is known, what is unique, a whole class, and the highest rank.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个冠词标记已知之物、唯一之物、一整类人以及最高等级。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger resting on the one object already recognised.
core.cn: 核心意象：手指稳稳点在那件已经被认出的东西上。

branches.en: The base sense points at something both people can identify.
branches.cn: 基本义指向双方都能辨认的东西。

branches.en: Being the only one makes a thing definite by itself.
branches.cn: 作为唯一之物，本身就使它成为定指。

branches.en: An adjective under the article stands for a whole class.
branches.cn: 冠词下的形容词代表一整类。

branches.en: The top rank is unique and therefore takes the same article.
branches.cn: 最高等级唯一，因此也使用同一个冠词。

branches.en: All three depend on the listener being able to fix the referent.
branches.cn: 三者都依赖听者能够确定所指。

intro.en: The is a native article, so the items are the demonstrative family it grew out of.
intro.cn: the 是本土冠词，所列条目是它由之生长出来的指示词族。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin element in the; the whole family is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: the 没有拉丁成分，整个词族都属日耳曼语。

items.example: The shrank from a full demonstrative.
items.exampleCN: the 由完整的指示词缩短而来。

items.example: This shares the same old stem.
items.exampleCN: this 共享同一个古老词干。

items.example: That is the far partner of this.
items.exampleCN: that 是 this 的远指伙伴。

items.example: These is the plural of this.
items.exampleCN: these 是 this 的复数。

items.example: Those is the plural of that.
items.exampleCN: those 是 that 的复数。

items.example: There comes from the same pointing stem.
items.exampleCN: there 来自同一个指认词干。

items.example: Then points to a time already fixed.
items.exampleCN: then 指向已经确定的时间。

items.example: Than keeps the old comparative use of the stem.
items.exampleCN: than 保留了这个词干的古老比较用法。

那个（远指）

definition_zh: 主题；题目；主旋律；（乐）主调；（店铺、派对等的）主题风格
definition_en: the main subject of a talk, book, or event; a recurring melody; or a style built around one idea
core_image: 一条主线从一堆素材里被抽出来：所有细节都挂在它上面
scene: 班会的横幅已经挂起来，孩子们在排练。The theme of this year's science week is water.
sceneCN: 这里 theme 是「主题」（第 1 个义项：谈话或活动的中心题目）；句意：今年科学周的主题是水。

pos.zh: 主题；题目；主旋律；（语法）主题位

derivatives.zh: 主题的；主题相关的（theme 加形容词后缀构成）
按主题地；主题上（thematic 加副词后缀）
把……设为主题（学术用语）
主题公园（复合词）

senses.title: The main subject of a work or talk
senses.definition: the subject or idea that a talk, book, film or event keeps returning to
senses.definitionCN: 谈话、书籍、电影或活动反复回归的题目或思想
senses.example: Loneliness is the theme of her latest novel.
senses.exampleCN: 孤独是她新小说的主题。
senses.why: Out of many details one line is pulled straight: everything else hangs on it.
senses.whyCN: 从繁杂细节中抽直一条线：其余一切都挂在上面。

senses.title: A recurring melody in music
senses.definition: a short melody that returns and is developed throughout a piece of music
senses.definitionCN: 在乐曲中反复出现并被展开的短旋律
senses.example: The opening theme returns before the final movement.
senses.exampleCN: 开头的主题在末乐章前再次出现。
senses.why: A melody can do what an idea does: leave and come back, each time wearing new clothes.
senses.whyCN: 旋律能做思想做的事：离开又归来，每次都换上新衣。

senses.title: A style built around one idea
senses.definition: a style or setting arranged around a single idea, as in a themed party or park
senses.definitionCN: 围绕单一观念布置的风格或场景，如主题派对、主题公园
senses.example: The café opens with a railway theme.
senses.exampleCN: 这家咖啡馆以铁路为主题开业。
senses.why: One idea becomes wallpaper, chairs and music: the theme leaves the page and furnishes the room.
senses.whyCN: 一个观念变成墙纸、座椅与音乐：主题离开纸面，开始布置房间。

senses.title: The starting point of a sentence in grammar
senses.definition: in linguistics, the point of departure of a sentence, what the sentence is about
senses.definitionCN: 语言学中句子的出发点，即句子所关涉者
senses.example: In this sentence, the weather stands as the theme.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个句子里，天气处于主题位。
senses.why: Grammar borrows the idea: a sentence also picks a line to hang its news on.
senses.whyCN: 语法借用此概念：句子也要挑一条线来挂自己的新信息。

intro.en: Theme goes back to Greek thema, a thing laid down or proposed, from tithenai, to place. The subject is literally the thing set down in front of the audience.
intro.cn: theme 可追溯到希腊语 thema「被放置、提出之物」，出自 tithenai「放置」。主题字面义就是摆在观众面前的那件东西。

items.en: Tithenai meant to place or set, and thema named what has been set down: a proposal, a subject.
items.cn: tithenai 意为放置；thema 指被放下之物：提案、题目。

items.en: The same placing root gave thesaurus, a treasure-house of laid-up words, and thesis, a thing set forth.
items.cn: 同一「放置」词根还给出 thesaurus「收藏语词的宝库」与 thesis「被摆出的论点」。

items.en: Latin borrowed thema and used it in rhetoric and music theory for the underlying subject.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入 thema，用于修辞学与音乐理论中的底层题目。

items.en: English took theme through Latin texts, at first for the subject of a logical proposition.
items.cn: 英语经拉丁文本借得 theme，最初指逻辑命题的题目。

items.en: Modern English extended it to music, then to parties and parks styled around one idea.
items.cn: 现代英语把它扩展到音乐，再扩展到围绕单一观念布置的派对与公园。

note.en: The first group walks the placing root into related words; the second separates theme from its near neighbours.
note.cn: 第一组沿「放置」词根走进相关词；第二组把 theme 与近邻分开。

entries.definition: a thing set forth; an argument placed before readers, from the same Greek placing root
entries.definitionCN: 论题；从同一希腊「放置」词根而来

entries.definition: the object pronoun; looks one letter from theme, unrelated in origin
entries.definitionCN: 宾格代词；字形只差一字母，词源无关

entries.definition: the adjective of theme, describing what belongs to the theme
entries.definitionCN: theme 的形容词，描述属于主题者

entries.definition: what is talked about; smaller and more concrete than theme
entries.definitionCN: 话题；比 theme 更小更具体

entries.definition: the area treated; subject names the field, theme names the idea inside it
entries.definitionCN: 题材；subject 指领域，theme 指其中思想

entries.definition: a recurring small pattern; a motif is a thread, a theme is the rope
entries.definitionCN: 反复出现的小图案；motif 是线，theme 是绳

normalIntro.en: Real links: the Greek placing root, the thesis of the same root, the theme song, and the themed café.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：希腊「放置」词根、同根的 thesis、主题曲、以及主题咖啡馆。

normal.en: Thema is a thing laid down: the subject placed before you.
normal.cn: thema 是被放下之物：摆在你面前的题目。

normal.en: Thesis and theme both come from placing something before readers.
normal.cn: thesis 与 theme 都来自「摆在读者面前」。

normal.en: A theme song returns like the idea it carries.
normal.cn: 主题曲像它承载的观念一样反复出现。

normal.en: Theme park: an idea big enough to furnish a whole park.
normal.cn: theme park：一个大到足以布置整座园子的观念。

normal.en: Motif is the thread; theme is the rope made of threads.
normal.cn: motif 是线；theme 是由线拧成的绳。

abstract.en: To have a theme is to choose what the rest must serve.
abstract.cn: 有了主题，就是选定其余一切必须服务的对象。

abstract.en: The strongest themes return quietly rather than loudly.
abstract.cn: 最有力的主题静默回归，而非喧哗。

abstract.en: An idea can decorate a room as easily as a paragraph.
abstract.cn: 观念布置房间与布置段落一样容易。

examples.en: The theme of the conference is cities and climate.
examples.cn: 本次大会的主题是城市与气候。

examples.en: The film's main theme returns at the closing scene.
examples.cn: 影片的主旋律在结尾场景再度响起。

examples.en: They decorated the hall on a harvest theme.
examples.cn: 他们以丰收为主题布置了大厅。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「西姆」——辩论赛抽到「西」「姆」两队对决，主题就定它了 → theme 主题

root: 希腊语 tithenai「放置」→ thema「被提出之物」→ 拉丁语 thema → 英语；同根词 thesis、thesaurus。

sensesIntro.en: From a thing set down before the audience, theme grows into the subject of works, the returning melody, the styled café or park, and even the grammarian's starting point.
sensesIntro.cn: 从摆在观众面前的物件出发，theme 长成作品题目、回归的旋律、有风格的咖啡馆与公园，乃至语法学家的出发点。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one line pulled straight out of a heap of material, everything hanging on it.
core.cn: 核心意象：从一堆材料中抽直的一条线，万物挂其上。

branches.en: The placed thing becomes the subject.
branches.cn: 被放下之物成为题目。

branches.en: A melody repeats the placing: it returns and returns.
branches.cn: 旋律重复这一放置：反复回归。

branches.en: The idea leaves the page to furnish real rooms.
branches.cn: 观念离开纸面去布置真实房间。

branches.en: Grammar keeps the line for sentence openings.
branches.cn: 语法为句首保留这条线。

branches.en: Subject and melody share the shape of return.
branches.cn: 题目与旋律共享「回归」的形状。

intro.en: Theme builds the adjective thematic, the adverb thematically, and compounds with park and song.
intro.cn: theme 构成形容词 thematic、副词 thematically，并与 park、song 复合。

latinIntro.en: Latin thema is the channel from Greek; the placing root also produced thesis and thesaurus.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 thema 是希腊词的通道；放置词根还造出 thesis 与 thesaurus。

items.example: The chapters follow a thematic order.
items.exampleCN: 章节按主题排序。

items.example: The book is thematically organised.
items.exampleCN: 本书按主题组织。

items.meaning: a statement set forth for argument
items.example: Her thesis defended a bold claim.
items.exampleCN: 她的论文为一个大胆论点辩护。

items.example: Use a thesaurus for richer wording.
items.exampleCN: 用同义词库丰富措辞。

items.meaning: a park built around one idea
items.example: The theme park opened in June.
items.exampleCN: 主题公园六月开园。

items.meaning: the song linked to a show
items.example: The theme song topped the charts.
items.exampleCN: 主题曲登顶排行榜。

items.example: The study thematizes urban loneliness.
items.exampleCN: 该研究把都市孤独设为主题。

items.meaning: a map showing one chosen theme
items.example: A thematic map traced the rainfall.
items.exampleCN: 专题地图描绘了降雨。

definition_zh: 然后；当时；那么；（紧接）于是；那时以来的
definition_en: at that time; next in order or consequence; or in that case, following from what has been said
core_image: 时间线上的下一格：上一个事件落定，指针才拨到它
scene: 烤箱计时器响了，她放下书起身。Beat the eggs, then fold in the flour gently.
sceneCN: 这里 then 是「然后」（第 1 个义项：紧接的下一时间）；句意：打散鸡蛋，然后轻轻拌入面粉。

collocations.zh: 不过话说回来；转念一想

derivatives.zh: 比（then 的孪生词，同出古英语一词后分化）
当场；立即（固定短语）
之后（同义时间副词，更书面）

senses.title: Next in time or order
senses.definition: at the next moment in a sequence of actions or events
senses.definitionCN: 在一系列动作或事件中的下一时刻
senses.example: Wash the rice, then soak it for an hour.

branches.en: The plural reaches animals and things without asking.

branches.en: Singular they fills the gap left by he and she.

branches.en: Both extensions come from the same neutrality: no gender, no species, no fuss.

definition_zh: 厚的；粗的；浓的；浓密的；愚蠢的；雾重的
definition_en: having a large distance between two sides, densely packed, not flowing easily, or slow to understand
core_image: 两大平面之间塞满了东西：一掌压不下去的厚
scene: 大雪整夜未停，清晨推开院门，积雪没了脚踝。The snow lay thick on the garden path.
sceneCN: 这里 thick 是「厚厚地积着、浓密」（第 3 个义项：密集铺满）；句意：花园小径上积雪很厚。

senses.title: Large between two surfaces
senses.definition: having a large distance between two opposite sides or surfaces
senses.definitionCN: 两个相对的面之间距离较大
senses.example: She wore a thick coat against the winter wind.
senses.exampleCN: 她穿上厚外套抵御寒风。
senses.why: The basic measure: a slab is thick when its two faces stand far apart, so the word names size across rather than along.
senses.whyCN: 最基本的量度：一块板的两面离得远就叫厚，这个词量的是横向的尺寸而不是纵向的。

senses.title: Densely packed together
senses.definition: growing or standing close together in large numbers
senses.definitionCN: 大量生长或聚集在一起，间距很小
senses.example: The forest is thick with pines and moss.
senses.exampleCN: 森林里松树和苔藓长得很密。
senses.why: When many things fill a space so closely that light struggles through, the crowding itself feels like thickness.
senses.whyCN: 当许多东西挤满一个空间、连光都难以穿过时，这种拥挤本身就让人感觉「厚」。

senses.title: Not flowing easily
senses.definition: (of a liquid) not flowing easily because it is dense or heavy
senses.definitionCN: 指液体浓稠、不易流动
senses.example: The sauce boiled down until it was thick and glossy.
senses.exampleCN: 酱汁熬到浓稠发亮。
senses.why: A dense liquid resists movement the way a thick plank resists bending, so the same word covers both blocks and broths.
senses.whyCN: 浓稠的液体抗拒流动，就像厚板抗拒弯折，同一个词便同时盖住了板块与汤汁。

senses.title: Slow to understand
senses.definition: (informal) not quick to understand, a little stupid
senses.definitionCN: （口语）理解得慢，有点迟钝
senses.example: Don't be thick, the answer is staring at you.
senses.exampleCN: 别犯迷糊了，答案就明摆在你眼前。
senses.why: An idea slides off a head as light slides off fog; the dense mind, like dense air, lets little through.
senses.whyCN: 想法滑不过一个脑袋，正如光穿不透浓雾；迟钝的头脑与浓重的空气一样，透不进多少东西。

senses.title: Heavy and hard to see through
senses.definition: (of fog, smoke, or air) heavy and difficult to see or breathe through
senses.definitionCN: 指雾、烟或空气浓重，难以看透或呼吸
senses.example: Thick smoke rolled down the stairwell.
senses.exampleCN: 浓烟涌下楼梯间。
senses.why: Smoke and fog fill space the way timber fills a wall, so seeing through them becomes as hard as drilling through a board.
senses.whyCN: 烟雾像木头填满墙壁一样填满空间，看穿它便变得像钻穿木板一样困难。

intro.en: Thick is a native Germanic word, old at the root: it goes back to an ancient word for densely pressed or crowded, and its cousins are found across the Germanic languages.
intro.cn: thick 是日耳曼本土词，词根十分古老：它追溯到表示「挤压密集」的古代词形，同源词遍布各日耳曼语言。

items.en: The common Germanic root is Theku, generally reconstructed as meaning thick, pressed close, or crowded; it had no Latin relatives.
items.cn: 公认的日耳曼词根一般重构为 Theku，意为「厚的、挤压紧密的、拥挤的」；它没有拉丁语同源词。

items.en: Old English Thicce already carried the main senses: solid in size, crowded in number, and heavy in texture.
items.cn: 古英语 Thicce 已具备主要义项：体积厚实、数量密集、质地浓重。

items.en: Norse Pokkr, a close cousin, reinforced the northern forms of the adjective.
items.cn: 古诺斯语的近亲词 Pokkr 加强了这一形容词在北方的形式。

items.en: Middle English thikke spread the figurative uses, and the adverb thikke(or thick) without -ly entered common speech.
items.cn: 中古英语 thikke 发展出比喻用法，无 -ly 的副词形式也进入日常口语。

items.en: Modern English fixed thick, thickly and thickness, and the idioms through thick and thin and thick as thieves gave the word a social flavour.
items.cn: 现代英语固定了 thick、thickly 与 thickness，习语 through thick and thin 和 thick as thieves 又给这个词添了人情味。

note.en: The first group holds the thick word family; the second compares adjectives of density and slowness.
note.cn: 第一组是 thick 词族；第二组比较表示密度与迟钝的形容词。

definition_zh: 想；思考；认为；回想；打算
definition_en: to use the mind to form ideas, opinions, or plans, or to hold something as an opinion

senses.title: To use the mind
senses.definition: to use the mind to form ideas, solve problems, or make decisions
senses.definitionCN: 运用头脑形成想法、解决问题或作出决定
senses.example: Give me a minute to think.
senses.exampleCN: 给我一分钟想一想。
senses.why: The core act: the mind works visibly hard, and the word simply names that work.
senses.whyCN: 核心行为：头脑明显地在劳作，这个词就是给这份劳作起名。

senses.title: To hold an opinion
senses.definition: to believe or hold something as an opinion, often less certain than know
senses.definitionCN: 相信或把某事当作看法，确定性低于 know
senses.example: I think the meeting starts at nine.
senses.exampleCN: 我想会议九点开始。
senses.why: An idea formed in the head is offered to the world as a claim; think marks the claim as personal and revisable.
senses.whyCN: 在头脑中形成的想法被作为主张交给世界；think 标记这主张属个人且可修正。

senses.title: To recall or imagine
senses.definition: to bring a past thing to mind, or to form a picture of something not present
senses.definitionCN: 让往事浮现心头，或构想不在眼前之物
senses.example: She still thinks of that summer by the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 她仍会想起海边那个夏天。
senses.why: The mind's workbench holds not only the present but the past and the possible; both arrive by the same act.
senses.whyCN: 头脑的工作台不只放当下，也放过去与可能；两者经由同一个动作到来。

senses.title: To intend or plan
senses.definition: to have a plan or intention in the mind, often in thinking of doing
senses.definitionCN: 心中存有计划或意图，常用于 thinking of doing
senses.example: We are thinking of moving to the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在考虑搬到海边住。
senses.why: A plan is an action rehearsed in the head before it happens; thinking is that rehearsal.
senses.whyCN: 计划是行动在头脑中的预演；thinking 就是这场预演。

senses.title: To expect or suppose
senses.definition: to expect or suppose that something will happen or is true
senses.definitionCN: 预期某事会发生或属实
senses.example: I think it will clear up by noon.
senses.exampleCN: 我料想到中午天会放晴。
senses.why: Opinion pointed forward becomes expectation: the same claim, wearing tomorrow's clothes.
senses.whyCN: 看法指向未来便成了预期：同一个主张，换上了明天的衣裳。

intro.en: Think is a native Germanic verb, and its strange past form thought preserves a very old sound pattern in which a t replaced the k of the present.
intro.cn: think 是日耳曼本土动词；其奇特的过去式 thought 保留了一种极古老的音变模式：过去式以 t 代替现在的 k。

items.en: The common Germanic root Thankjan meant to seem or to appear to the mind; the same root gave both think and seem in some relatives.
items.cn: 公认日耳曼词根 Thankjan 意为「在心中显现、似乎」；同一词根在部分亲属语言中既给出 think 也给出 seem 义。

items.en: Old English had two verbs: Thencan, to think in the modern sense, and Thyncan, to seem. Their past forms crossed and merged.
items.cn: 古英语有两个动词：Thencan（现代的「想」）与 Thyncan（「似乎」）；二者的过去式相互交叉并合流。

items.en: Middle English merged the two verbs into think with past thought, and the seeming sense faded away.
items.cn: 中古英语将两词合并为 think，过去式 thought，「似乎」义渐消。

items.en: Modern English fixed the paradigm think, thought and built a wide family: thinker, thoughtful, thoughtless, overthink.
items.cn: 现代英语固定 think-thought 范式，并衍生出 thinker、thoughtful、thoughtless、overthink 等庞大家族。

items.en: The noun think (have a think) and think tank show the verb moving into noun jobs in modern colloquial and institutional English.
items.cn: 名词 think（have a think）与 think tank 显示该动词在现代口语与机构用语中转任名词。

note.en: The first group is the think-thought family; the second compares verbs of mind work.
note.cn: 第一组是 think-thought 词族；第二组比较各种「心智劳作」动词。

senses.title: The thing near the speaker

senses.exampleCN: 这个杯子很烫。

senses.whyCN: 说话人指向触手可及的东西，一个短促的词就标记了靠近。

senses.title: What has just been said
senses.definition: referring to something just said or happening now

senses.exampleCN: 这就是我的意思。

senses.whyCN: 刚说出口的话在对话里仍算「近」，于是近指词把它接住。

senses.title: So or this much

sensesIntro.cn: 这个近指词覆盖手边的一件东西、刚说出的一句话，以及用来比较的程度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger tapping the object right at hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：手指点着就在手边的那件东西。

branches.en: The base sense marks a single thing close to the speaker.
branches.cn: 基本义标记离说话人很近的一件东西。

branches.en: Something just said is also close, so this takes it up.
branches.cn: 刚说出口的话也很近，于是 this 把它接住。

branches.en: Closeness to a point of comparison turns into degree.
branches.cn: 与比较点的接近转化为程度。

branches.en: Both rest on the idea of what is near.
branches.cn: 两者都建立在「近」的观念上。

branches.en: Space and degree are measured from the same near point.
branches.cn: 空间与程度都从同一个近点量起。

scene: 朋友劝他别去山上，他笑着答应着，脚下还是往山路走。He set out for the summit though the clouds were closing in.
sceneCN: 这里 though 是「虽然、尽管」（第 1 个义项：让步从属连词）；句意为尽管乌云正在合拢，他还是出发去山顶了。

pos.zh: 虽然；尽管（引导让步状语从句）

senses.title: In spite of the fact that
senses.definition: used to introduce a fact that makes the main statement surprising or contrasting
senses.definitionCN: 用来引出一个使主句显得意外或形成对照的事实
senses.example: Though the road was steep, they reached the top before noon.
senses.exampleCN: 虽然山路陡峭，他们还是在中午前到达山顶。
senses.why: The word began as the same form as that, and grew into a marker that sets one clause against another.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初与 that 同形，后来演变成把一个分句与另一个分句对立起来的标记。

senses.title: However, at the end of a clause
senses.definition: placed at the end of a sentence to add a softer however or a second thought
senses.definitionCN: 放在句末，补充一个语气较软的「不过」或事后想法
senses.example: It is a small flat. Very cosy, though.
senses.exampleCN: 这是一套小公寓，不过很温馨。
senses.why: The contrast marker drifts to the end of the sentence, where it sounds like a spoken afterthought.
senses.whyCN: 这个转折标记漂到句末，听起来像说话人事后补上的念头。

senses.title: As if, in as though
senses.definition: in the phrase as though, meaning as if, used for an imagined situation
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 as though，意为「好像」，表示设想的情形
senses.example: He spoke as though he had known her for years.
senses.exampleCN: 他说话的样子好像已经认识她多年。
senses.why: Comparison and concession share one marker: a clause that does not quite match the main one.
senses.whyCN: 比较与让步共用一个标记：一个与主句并不完全相符的分句。

senses.title: Even though: a stronger concession
senses.definition: in the phrase even though, introducing a fact that does not change the result
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 even though，引出一个并不改变结果的事实
senses.example: Even though the shop was closed, a light still burned inside.
senses.exampleCN: 即使店铺已经关门，里面仍亮着灯。
senses.why: Adding even pushes the contrast to its limit: the fact is granted in full and the main clause still stands.
senses.whyCN: 加上 even 把对立推到极限：事实被完全承认，主句依然成立。

intro.en: Though is a native English word built on the old demonstrative stem, a close relative of that.
intro.cn: though 是英语本土词，建立在古老的指示词干之上，与 that 是近亲。

items.en: The Germanic demonstrative stem *þa- supplied words for pointing at something, including then and there.
items.cn: 日耳曼语指示词干 *þa- 提供了一批指称某物的词，包括 then 与 there。

items.en: Old English þeah was both a concessive conjunction and an adverb meaning nevertheless.
items.cn: 古英语 þeah 既是让步连词，也作副词表示「然而」。

items.en: Middle English spelling settled toward though, and the word kept both jobs, conjunction and sentence-final adverb.
items.cn: 中古英语拼写逐渐定为 though，这个词保留了两个用途：连词与句末副词。

items.en: The compound although, formed with all, became the more formal written choice, while though stayed common in speech.
items.cn: 由 all 构成的 although 成为更正式的书面选择，though 则在口语中保持常用。

items.en: As though and even though fixed the two special uses, comparison and reinforced concession.
items.cn: as though 与 even though 固定了两个专门用法：比拟与强化让步。

note.en: The first group separates the though family and its easily confused look-alikes; the second compares concessive and contrast words.
note.cn: 第一组区分 though 词族与易混的形近词；第二组比较让步与转折类词。

normal.en: Although is all plus though, and it is the cooler, more written version.

normal.en: Though at the end is a spoken afterthought, like a shrug after a sentence.

normal.cn: though 不是 through 也不是 thought：下笔前看清元音和结尾。

abstract.cn: 想象一块指向前方又突然拐弯的路牌：主句继续前进，让步从句拐向一旁。

abstract.en: Though is the small hinge on which two opposite facts swing.
abstract.cn: though 是让两个相反事实摆动的那个小铰链。

abstract.en: The word nods at one fact and keeps walking toward the other.

sensesIntro.en: All four uses of though mark a mismatch: a fact that does not stop the main clause, an afterthought at the end, an imagined comparison, and a concession pushed to its limit.
sensesIntro.cn: though 的四种用法都在标记「不相符」：挡不住主句的事实、句末的补充、设想中的比拟，以及推到极限的让步。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sentence that nods at one fact and then turns its head to another.

branches.en: The standard concession: the fact is granted, the main clause still stands.

branches.en: The spoken tail: contrast dropped at the end like an afterthought.
branches.cn: 口语尾音线：转折被丢到句末，像事后想起。

branches.en: The imagined scene: as though lines up a picture with reality.
branches.cn: 想象场景线：as though 把一幅画面与现实并列。

branches.en: The limit: even though grants everything and still holds.
branches.cn: 极限线：even though 全部承认之后依然成立。

branches.en: Written and spoken halves of the same hinge word.

senses.title: From one side to the other
senses.definition: from one end, side or surface of something to the other

senses.example: The river runs through the centre of the town.
senses.exampleCN: 这条河从镇中心穿过。
senses.why: The word is a preposition of motion built on a root for passing, and this is its oldest and most physical use.

senses.exampleCN: 她通过公司里的一位朋友得到了这份工作。
senses.why: A path through a place becomes a means through a system: the physical route turns into a channel.
senses.whyCN: 穿过某地的路变成穿过某体系的途径：实体路线转为渠道。

senses.example: The shop stayed open through the holiday.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店整个假期都开门。
senses.why: Space and time share the image: a period is crossed the way a tunnel is crossed.
senses.whyCN: 空间与时间共用这个意象：跨越一段时间就像穿过一条隧道。

senses.title: Finished, or completed
senses.definition: finished with something, especially in the phrase be through with
senses.definitionCN: 完成某事，尤用于 be through with 短语
senses.example: Are you through with the computer? I need it.
senses.exampleCN: 你用完了电脑吗？我要用。
senses.why: To be through an object is to have come out the other side, so the work is behind you.
senses.whyCN: 穿过某物意味着已从另一侧出来，工作因此被留在身后。

senses.title: Connected by phone
senses.definition: connected to the person you want on the telephone, in the phrase get through
senses.definitionCN: 在电话中联系上要找的人，用于 get through
senses.example: I tried several times but could not get through.
senses.exampleCN: 我试了好几次都没接通。
senses.why: A call travels through the network until it reaches someone, so connecting is getting through.
senses.whyCN: 通话穿过网络抵达某人，因此接通就是 get through。

intro.en: Through is one of the oldest prepositions in English, from a Germanic root for passing across.
intro.cn: through 是英语最古老的介词之一，源自表示「穿过」的日耳曼词根。

items.en: The root meant to go over or through, a picture of a door or gate being crossed.
items.cn: 词根意为「越过、穿过」，是穿过门或关口的画面。

items.en: Old English þurh was a preposition of motion and means, used both for space and for agency.
items.cn: 古英语 þurh 既是运动介词也表手段，兼指空间与施事。

items.en: Middle English through absorbed Norse influence and settled the initial thr- spelling and pronunciation.
items.cn: 中古英语 through 受北欧语影响，固定了 thr- 的拼写与读音。

items.en: The adjective thorough split off early, taking over the sense of complete, and the adverb throughout was built with out.
items.cn: 形容词 thorough 很早就分离出去，接管「彻底」义，副词 throughout 则由 out 复合而成。

items.en: Modern English extends through to time and to communication, so a call and a holiday can both be got through.
items.cn: 现代英语把 through 扩展到时间与通信，于是电话与假期都能「过」。

note.en: The first group separates through from its spelling neighbours and relatives; the second compares prepositions of movement.
note.cn: 第一组区分 through 与形近、同族词；第二组比较表示运动的介词。

entries.definition: The adjective for complete and careful, split off from the same word.
entries.definitionCN: 彻底的（与 through 同源后分化）

entries.definition: Through plus out, meaning in every part or the whole of a period.
The concessive conjunction; it differs in vowel and voice.
entries.definitionCN: 虽然（元音与清浊音都不同）

entries.definition: To excite strongly; the opening looks similar but the root differs.
entries.definitionCN: 使兴奋；开头形近，词源不同

entries.definition: From one side to the other of a surface, rather than an inside.
Following the length of something, not crossing it.
By way of; a Latin word for routing and means.
With the help of; a formal phrase for instrument and method.

normalIntro.en: Hooks from the pass-through root, the twin thorough, and the compound throughout.
normalIntro.cn: 钩子来自「穿过」词根、孪生词 thorough，以及复合词 throughout。

normal.en: Through and thorough are twins: one crosses, the other has crossed right to the end.
normal.cn: through 与 thorough 是双胞胎：一个在穿，一个已经穿到底。

normal.en: Throughout is through plus out, covering every part.
normal.cn: throughout 就是 through 加 out，覆盖每一部分。

normal.en: Through can cross time: all through the night is a tunnel made of hours.
normal.cn: through 能穿过时间：all through the night 是一条由小时组成的隧道。

normal.en: Get through on the phone means the call has crossed the network to a person.
normal.cn: get through 意为通话穿过网络到达了人。

normal.en: Do not write it as though: that word means although.
normal.cn: 不要写成 though：那是「虽然」。

abstract.en: Picture a tunnel crossing a mountain with light at both ends.
abstract.cn: 想象一条贯穿山体的隧道，两头都有光。

abstract.en: Space, time and method are all tunnels the word digs.
abstract.cn: 空间、时间与方法，都是这个词挖出的隧道。

abstract.en: To be through something is to have left it behind.
abstract.cn: be through 某物，就是把它留在了身后。

examples.en: We walked through the old market on the way home.
examples.cn: 回家路上我们穿过老市场。

examples.en: He worked through the night to finish the design.
examples.cn: 他通宵赶完了设计。

examples.en: I got the news through a colleague.
examples.cn: 我是通过一位同事得知这个消息的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「出路」——找到出路就是穿过去 → through 穿过

root: 古英语 þurh，源自日耳曼语「越过、穿过」词根，同源孪生词 thorough 后分化出「彻底」义；throughout 由 through + out 复合而成。

sensesIntro.en: Through digs one tunnel and drives it through space, method, time, a finished task and a phone line.
sensesIntro.cn: through 只挖一条隧道，却把它打通了空间、手段、时间、完成的任务与电话线路。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tunnel crossing a mountain, light at both ends.
core.cn: 核心意象：贯穿山体、两头见光的隧道。

branches.en: The place: right through the middle.
branches.cn: 空间线：从正中穿过。

branches.en: The channel: through a friend, through hard work.
branches.cn: 渠道线：通过朋友、通过努力。

branches.en: The stretch: through the night, through the year.
branches.cn: 时段线：通宵、整年。

branches.en: The ending: through a task, through to a caller.
branches.cn: 终点线：做完了事，接通了电话。

branches.en: Space and time use one and the same image.
branches.cn: 空间与时间共用同一个意象。

intro.en: Through compounds productively: throughout, breakthrough, and the split-off adjective thorough.
intro.cn: through 能构成许多复合词：throughout、breakthrough，以及分化出去的 thorough。

latinIntro.en: The word is native Germanic, so the Latin entry list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 本词为日耳曼本土词，拉丁词条留空。

items.meaning: in every part; all the time
items.example: It rained throughout the day.
items.exampleCN: 雨下了一整天。

items.example: A breakthrough in research.
items.exampleCN: 研究上的突破。

items.example: A thorough check.
items.exampleCN: 彻底的检查。

items.example: Walk through the park.
items.exampleCN: 穿过公园。

items.example: The plant’s throughput doubled.
items.exampleCN: 该厂的吞吐量翻了一番。

items.example: A see-through curtain.
items.exampleCN: 透明的窗帘。

items.example: Fly via Dubai.
items.exampleCN: 经迪拜飞行。

items.meaning: from one side to the other
items.example: Walk across the bridge.
items.exampleCN: 走过桥。

definition_zh: 扔；投掷；抛；（使）陷入（某种状态）；举办
definition_en: to send something through the air with your hand, or to cause someone to be in a particular state
core_image: 手臂向后一拉，手腕一甩，东西划出一道弧线飞出去
scene: 院子里父子俩来回扔着球,球在阳光下划出一道又一道弧线。The father threw the ball high and the boy ran to catch it.
sceneCN: 这里 throw 是「扔、抛」（第 1 个义项：用手把东西投向空中）；句意为父亲把球高高扔起，男孩跑过去接住。

pos.zh: 使陷入（某种状态）；使困惑
举办（聚会）；投射（光线、影子）

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 构成，义为「投掷者；（机器）抛掷装置」
由 throw 与 away 复合，义为「用完即弃的；随口说出的话」
由 throw 与 back 复合，义为「复古之物；返祖现象」

senses.title: To send something through the air
senses.definition: to send something through the air with your hand, using a quick movement of the arm
senses.definitionCN: 用手臂快速动作把东西送向空中
senses.example: He threw the keys across the table to me.
senses.exampleCN: 他把钥匙隔着桌子扔给我。
senses.why: The root meant to twist or turn, and the arm turns as it hurls something away.
senses.whyCN: 词根意为「扭、转」，手臂在甩出东西时正是扭转的。

senses.title: To make someone be in a state
senses.definition: to cause someone or something to be suddenly in a particular state or situation
senses.definitionCN: 使人或事物突然进入某种状态或处境
senses.example: The news threw the whole office into confusion.
senses.exampleCN: 这个消息让整个办公室陷入混乱。
senses.why: A blow of feeling hurls a mind the way a hand hurls a stone.
senses.whyCN: 情绪的打击把心甩出去，就像手甩出一块石头。

senses.title: To shine or cast light and shadow
senses.definition: to send light or shadow onto a surface
senses.definitionCN: 把光或影投到某表面上
senses.example: The low sun threw long shadows across the field.
senses.exampleCN: 低斜的太阳在田野上投下长长的影子。
senses.why: Light and shadow are thrown like objects: they travel from the source and land on a surface.
senses.whyCN: 光与影像物体一样被抛出：从源头飞出，落在表面上。

senses.title: To hold a party or event
senses.definition: to organise and hold a party, dinner or similar social event
senses.definitionCN: 组织和举办聚会、晚宴等社交活动
senses.example: They threw a party for her return.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为她的归来办了一场聚会。
senses.why: A party is launched the way an object is thrown: set in motion and let go.
senses.whyCN: 聚会像物体一样被抛出：先使它动起来，再松手放手。

senses.title: To be pushed off a horse or in a fight
senses.definition: to make a rider fall from a horse, or to make someone fall in a fight
senses.definitionCN: 使骑手从马上摔下，或在搏斗中把对方摔倒
senses.example: The horse threw its rider at the first fence.
senses.exampleCN: 那匹马在第一道栅栏处把骑手摔了下来。
senses.why: The rider is thrown off, the same physical hurl applied to a person.
senses.whyCN: 骑手被甩了下来，还是那同一次物理的投掷，只是对象换成了人。

intro.en: Throw is a native English verb from a root meaning to twist or turn, the same family as thread.
intro.cn: throw 是英语本土动词，源自意为「扭、转」的词根，与 thread 同族。

items.en: The root meant to twist or turn round, which describes the motion of an arm hurling something.
items.cn: 词根意为「扭、转」，正描述手臂甩出东西的动作。

items.en: Old English þrāwan meant to twist or turn, and only later took on the sense of hurling through the air.
items.cn: 古英语 þrāwan 意为「扭、转」，后来才获得「抛向空中」之义。

items.en: Middle English throw covered casting, hurling and even throwing a rider, and the noun throw appeared beside it.
items.cn: 中古英语 throw 兼指投、掷，乃至把骑手摔下，旁生名词 throw。

items.en: Modern English added abstract and social uses: to throw light on a question, to throw a party.
items.cn: 现代英语增添了抽象与社交用法：throw light on a question、throw a party。

items.en: The phrasal patterns, throw away and throw up, gave the verb a large second life in everyday speech.
items.cn: throw away 与 throw up 这类短语搭配，让这个动词在日常口语中获得了极大的第二生命。

note.en: The first group gathers the throwing family and near spellings; the second compares verbs of sending things outward.
note.cn: 第一组收投掷词族与形近词；第二组比较表示「送出」的动词。

entries.definition: The past tense, sounding like through but meaning threw.
entries.definitionCN: 过去式；读音与 through 相同

entries.definition: The past participle, used after have or be.
A person or machine that throws.
From one side to the other; the same sound as threw.
To throw lightly or carelessly, often upward.
To throw with great force, often in anger.
To throw with a sudden, wild movement.
To throw or send out, especially light, a shadow or a vote.
entries.definitionCN: 投；投射（正式，常用于光、影、票）

normalIntro.en: Hooks from the twisting root, the irregular forms and the phrasal uses.
normalIntro.cn: 钩子来自「扭、转」词根、不规则变化，以及短语搭配。

normal.en: Throw, threw, thrown: the vowel shifts from -ow to -ew to -own, like grow and blow.
normal.cn: throw, threw, thrown：元音从 -ow 变 -ew 再到 -own，与 grow、blow 相同。

normal.en: Thrown is the past participle; threw is only for the simple past.
normal.cn: thrown 是过去分词；threw 只用于一般过去时。

normal.en: The root meant to twist, and your arm twists as it throws.
normal.cn: 词根意为「扭」，手臂在扔出时正是扭转的。

normal.en: Throw light on means to make a problem clear, as if light were thrown at it.
normal.cn: throw light on 意为让问题变清楚，就像把光投在上面。

normal.en: Throw a party does not mean throwing anything away: it means holding one.
normal.cn: throw a party 不是把聚会扔掉，而是举办聚会。

abstract.en: Picture a stone leaving the hand in a curve, the arm still turning behind it.
abstract.cn: 想象石头以弧线离手，手臂还在身后转动。

abstract.en: The verb sends not just objects but light, shadows and states of mind.
abstract.cn: 这个动词送出的不只是物体，还有光、影与心境。

abstract.en: Everything thrown is briefly free of the hand that held it.
abstract.cn: 被抛出的一切，都短暂地离开了托着它的手。

examples.en: She threw the ball back over the fence.
examples.cn: 她把球扔回栅栏那边。

examples.en: The report throws new light on the accident.
examples.cn: 这份报告让事故有了新的解释。

examples.en: They threw a party when the project was finished.
examples.cn: 项目完成后他们办了一场聚会。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「思入」——把思虑一股脑扔进风里 → throw 扔

root: 古英语 þrāwan，源自日耳曼词根「扭、转」（与 thread 同族），本义「扭转」，后转指以扭转的手臂抛掷；由物理投掷引申出投射光影子、使人陷入状态、举办活动等义。

sensesIntro.en: Throw begins as an arm twisting something into the air and then throws light, shadows, states of mind and even parties.
sensesIntro.cn: throw 起初是手臂一扭把东西甩向空中，后来也抛出光、影、心境，乃至一场聚会。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stone leaving the hand in a curve, the arm still turning.
core.cn: 核心意象：石头以弧线离手，手臂仍在转动。

branches.en: The object: keys, a ball, a stone.
branches.cn: 物体线：钥匙、球、石头。

branches.en: The abstract throw: feelings and shadows flung outward.
branches.cn: 抽象线：情绪与影子被甩出去。

branches.en: The social throw: a party organised and launched.
branches.cn: 社交线：聚会从筹办到开启。

branches.en: The violent throw: a rider off a horse.
branches.cn: 暴力线：骑手被摔下马。

branches.en: Hand and emotion share one hurling verb.
branches.cn: 手与情绪共用同一个「甩」的动词。

intro.en: Throw takes -er for the doer, and it compounds with away and back.
intro.cn: throw 加 -er 表施事者，并与 away、back 构成复合词。

latinIntro.en: The word is native Germanic, so the Latin entry list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 本词为日耳曼本土词，拉丁词条留空。

items.example: It forms thrower.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 thrower。

items.example: It forms throws.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 throws。

items.example: Throw me the ball.
items.exampleCN: 把球扔给我。

items.example: A throwaway cup.
items.exampleCN: 一次性杯子。

items.meaning: a return to an older type
items.example: A throwback to the sixties.
items.exampleCN: 回到六十年代的感觉。

items.example: A needle and thread.
items.exampleCN: 针和线。

items.example: He hurled the stone.
items.exampleCN: 他猛力掷出石头。

items.example: Project the image on the wall.
items.exampleCN: 把影像投到墙上。

definition_zh: 票；入场券；罚单；（政党）候选人名单
definition_en: a piece of paper or a digital pass that gives you the right to travel, enter or attend something
core_image: 一张印着几行小字的小纸片，检票口看一眼就放行
scene: 出门赶车前他忽然在口袋里翻找,怕那张小纸片弄丢了。She checked her pocket twice to make sure the ticket was still there.
sceneCN: 这里 ticket 是「车票」（第 1 个义项：凭以乘车的小票据）；句意为她摸了两次口袋，确认车票还在。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「售票；开罚单」
由动词加 -ed 构成，义为「持票的；被开罚单的」
由 ticket 与 holder 复合，义为「持票人」

senses.title: A pass for travel or entry
senses.definition: a printed or digital piece of evidence giving the holder the right to travel or enter
senses.definitionCN: 纸质或电子凭证，持者有乘车或入场的权利
senses.example: Two return tickets to the city, please.
senses.exampleCN: 请给我两张到城里的往返票。
senses.why: The word began as a written note, and a note is enough to pass a gate.
senses.whyCN: 这个词起初是一张书面便条，而一张便条足以通过一道闸。

senses.title: A notice of a fine
senses.definition: an official notice that you must pay a fine for a traffic or parking offence
senses.definitionCN: 因交通或停车违章而须缴纳罚款的正式通知
senses.example: There was a parking ticket under the windscreen wiper.
senses.exampleCN: 雨刷下夹着一张违章停车罚单。
senses.why: The right to pass became a right to punish: the same slip of paper, in another colour.
senses.whyCN: 「准予通行」变成了「予以处罚」：同一张小纸片，换了个颜色。

senses.title: A means to an end
senses.definition: in phrases such as a ticket to success, the thing that enables you to reach a goal
senses.definitionCN: 用于 a ticket to success 一类短语，指使人达到目标的手段
senses.example: Fluent English was her ticket to a better job.
senses.exampleCN: 流利的英语是她得到更好工作的门径。
senses.why: Whatever lets you through a door is a ticket, even when it is not paper.
senses.whyCN: 凡是能让你通过一道门的东西都是 ticket，即使它不是纸。

senses.title: A political list of candidates
senses.definition: the list of candidates that a party puts forward in an election
senses.definitionCN: 政党在选举中推出的候选人名单
senses.example: He won a place on the party ticket.
senses.exampleCN: 他赢得了该党名单上的一个位置。
senses.why: Candidates travel on one list as passengers travel on one ticket.
senses.whyCN: 候选人同上一个名单，就像乘客凭同一张票同行。

intro.en: Ticket came into English from French, where it began as a short note rather than a travel pass.
intro.cn: ticket 经法语进入英语，最初指一张短小的便条，而非车票。

items.en: Old French estiquet meant a note or a label, something stuck onto a document or a door.
items.cn: 古法语 estiquet 意为便条或标签，是贴在文书或门上的东西。

items.en: Middle English borrowed the word as ticket, and it named a written note, a licence or a short record.
items.cn: 中古英语借入作 ticket，指书面便条、许可证或简短记录。

items.en: By the seventeenth century ticket had become the slip that admits you to a coach, a play or a lottery draw.
items.cn: 到十七世纪，ticket 已指让人乘车、看戏或抽签的凭据。

items.en: The nineteenth century added the police sense, the ticket that charges rather than admits.
items.cn: 十九世纪增添了警察用法：不再放行而是处罚的票单。

items.en: Modern English made tickets digital, but the word still means the right to go through.
items.cn: 现代英语让票数字化了，但这个词仍表示「可以过去」的权利。

note.en: The first group separates ticket from near spellings; the second compares passes, vouchers and fines.
note.cn: 第一组区分 ticket 与形近词；第二组比较票证、凭单与罚款。

entries.definition: A check mark, or a small insect; one syllable less and another root.
entries.definitionCN: 勾；蜱虫（少一个音节，词源不同）

entries.definition: To touch lightly and make someone laugh.
The rise and fall of the sea; a different root entirely.
An adhesive label, literally a thing stuck on.
entries.definitionCN: 贴纸（同源，本义「贴上去的东西」）

entries.definition: A card or document that lets you enter freely, often repeatedly.
A printed piece of paper exchangeable for goods or money.
The money paid for a journey, not the paper itself.
Money paid as a penalty; the ticket is only the notice of it.
entries.definitionCN: 罚款（票只是通知，钱才是罚）

normalIntro.en: Hooks from the short-note origin and the two opposite jobs of the same slip.
normalIntro.cn: 钩子来自「便条」的来源，以及同一纸片两种相反的职责。

normal.en: Ticket began as a little note, and a note still gets you through a gate.
normal.cn: ticket 最初是一张小便条，而一张便条仍能让你过闸。

normal.en: A travel ticket lets you go; a parking ticket stops you with a fine.
normal.cn: 车票放你过去，罚单则用罚款拦住你。

normal.en: Ticket office is where you pay before, the ticket machine where you pay quickly.
normal.cn: ticket office 是提前买票的地方，ticket machine 是快速买票的机器。

normal.en: A ticket to success is not paper; it is whatever opens the door.
normal.cn: 通往成功的 ticket 不是纸，而是任何能开门的凭据。

normal.en: Do not mix it with tick or tide: check the middle letters.
normal.cn: 不要与 tick 或 tide 混：看清中间的字母。

abstract.en: Picture a small slip flicked across a counter, the one thing that decides whether you pass.
abstract.cn: 想象一张小纸片从柜台那头弹过来，它单单决定你能不能过去。

abstract.en: The word is a legal token: it carries permission in miniature.
abstract.cn: 这个词是一枚微型的法律凭证，把许可装在小尺寸里。

abstract.en: The same paper can open a door or close a bank account.
abstract.cn: 同一张纸可以打开一扇门，也可以掏空一个账户。

examples.en: I booked two tickets for the evening train.
examples.cn: 我订了两张晚班火车的票。

examples.en: He got a ticket for parking on the pavement.
examples.cn: 他因为人行道上停车被开了罚单。

examples.en: Good writing is still a ticket to better work.
examples.cn: 好文笔仍是通往更好工作的门径。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「替课特」——替人上课特批一张凭条 → ticket 票

root: 古法语 estiquet「便条、标签」，中古英语借入为 ticket，本指书面便条或许可；十七世纪转指乘车看戏的凭据，十九世纪又衍生出交警罚单义。

sensesIntro.en: Ticket is a small slip that carries permission, and the same shape of paper can also carry a penalty, a career chance or a party list.
sensesIntro.cn: ticket 是一张承载许可的小纸片，同一形状的纸也能承载罚款、职业机会或政党名单。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small slip flicked across a counter that decides whether you pass.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张从柜台弹来的小纸片，决定你能不能过去。

branches.en: The pass: permission in miniature.
branches.cn: 通行线：微缩的许可。

branches.en: The fine: the same slip turned against you.
branches.cn: 罚款线：同一纸片反过来对付你。

branches.en: The chance: whatever opens a door.
branches.cn: 机会线：任何能开门的凭据。

branches.en: The list: candidates travelling together on one ballot.
branches.cn: 名单线：候选人共用一张选票同行。

branches.en: Two opposite powers share one small piece of paper.
branches.cn: 两种相反的权力共住一张小纸片。

intro.en: Ticket takes -s, -ed and -ing; it compounds with office, holder and machine.
intro.cn: ticket 可加 -s、-ed、-ing，并与 office、holder、machine 复合。

latinIntro.cn: 词干经法语而来，源出表示「粘贴」的古老词根，此处无需拉丁词条。

definition_zh: 领带；绳子；联系；平局；系；绑；打结；打平
definition_en: to fasten something with string or rope, or a strip of cloth worn round the neck; also a bond between people or a level score
core_image: 两根绳头被拉紧打成一个结，两样东西从此连在一起
scene: 比赛进入最后一分钟，两队分数还完全相同。The two teams were still tied at two goals each when the whistle blew.
sceneCN: 这里 tie 是「打成平局」（第 7 个义项：比分相同）；句意为哨响时两队仍是二比二平。画面里有记分牌、哨子与球员。

pos.zh: 动词：系、绑、打结；打平；相配
名词：领带；绳子；联系；平局

derivatives.zh: 加否定前缀 un- 构成，义为「解开；松开」
由过去分词形容词化，义为「被系住的；捆绑的」
复合词，义为「决胜局；平局决胜」
由现在分词名词化，义为「打结；系缚的动作」

senses.title: To fasten with string or rope
senses.definition: to fasten something or someone with string, rope, or a similar material
senses.definitionCN: 用绳子或类似材料把某物或某人固定住
senses.example: He tied the boat to the post before the storm came.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨来临前，他把小船拴在柱子上。
senses.why: The Old English verb meant to bind, and every later sense grows out of that single act of pulling two things together.
senses.whyCN: 古英语动词意为「捆绑」，此后所有义项都从这一个把两样东西拉在一起的动作长出。

senses.title: To make a knot
senses.definition: to form a knot by crossing and pulling the ends of a string
senses.definitionCN: 把绳子的两端交叉拉紧做成结
senses.example: She tied her shoelaces twice to be safe.
senses.exampleCN: 为了保险，她把鞋带系了两道。
senses.why: A knot is what a bind leaves behind: a small permanent object made of the act of binding.
senses.whyCN: 结是捆绑留下的东西：一个由捆绑动作做成的小小固定物。

senses.title: A necktie
senses.definition: a narrow strip of cloth worn around the neck and tied at the front
senses.definitionCN: 系在颈前打结的窄条布料
senses.example: He chose a dark tie for the interview.
senses.exampleCN: 他挑了一条深色领带参加面试。
senses.why: The tie is literally a binding round the neck, wearing the original act on the body.
senses.whyCN: 领带就是颈上的一圈系缚，把原始动作穿在了身上。

senses.title: A bond between people
senses.definition: a connection of affection, duty, or shared experience between people
senses.definitionCN: 人与人之间由感情、责任或共同经历形成的连结
senses.example: The two sisters kept a close tie after moving to different cities.
senses.exampleCN: 搬去不同城市后，两姐妹仍保持紧密的联系。
senses.why: Two separate lives are bound together just as two ends are bound in a knot.
senses.whyCN: 两条独立的生活被绑在一起，正如两个绳头在结中相绑。

senses.title: A draw in a game
senses.definition: a result in which two sides have the same score
senses.definitionCN: 双方得分相同的结果
senses.example: The final ended in a tie.
senses.exampleCN: 决赛以平局收场。
senses.why: No side is pulled tighter than the other, so the two remain bound level on the scoreboard.
senses.whyCN: 两边谁都没被拉得更紧，于是在记分牌上停在同一水平。

senses.title: To score level
senses.definition: to make the score equal in a game or contest
senses.definitionCN: 在比赛或竞赛中把比分拉成相同
senses.example: A late goal tied the game at one each.
senses.exampleCN: 临近终场的一个进球把比分扳成一比一。
senses.why: The verb repeats the noun: the sides become bound level by a single action.
senses.whyCN: 动词复现了名词：一次动作让双方落到同一水平。

senses.title: To be tied at a score
senses.definition: to be in a position where both sides have the same score in a match
senses.definitionCN: 比赛中双方得分相同的状态
senses.example: The teams were tied at two goals each when the whistle blew.
senses.exampleCN: 哨响时两队仍是二比二平。
senses.why: A level score holds the two sides together, unable to break away.
senses.whyCN: 平分把双方拴在一起，谁也无法拉开。

senses.title: To be connected with
senses.definition: to be closely connected with or to match another thing
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事物密切相关或相互配合
senses.example: The new album ties in with the film of the same name.
senses.exampleCN: 这张新专辑与同名电影相互配合。
senses.why: What is joined by a string moves together, so things that must be understood together are said to tie in.
senses.whyCN: 用绳连着的东西会一起移动，因此须一同理解的事物也说成 tie in。

senses.title: A railway sleeper
senses.definition: a heavy wooden or concrete support laid across a railway track
senses.definitionCN: 横铺在铁轨下的粗木或混凝土支撑物
senses.example: The workers replaced every tie along the old line.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们更换了旧线路上的每一根枕木。
senses.why: The sleeper is a tie because it ties the two steel rails to a fixed distance.
senses.whyCN: 枕木之所以叫 tie，是因为它把两条钢轨拴在固定间距上。

senses.title: To restrict by duty
senses.definition: to limit someone's freedom of action by duty, rules, or promises
senses.definitionCN: 通过责任、规则或承诺限制某人的行动自由
senses.example: The contract ties him to the company for three years.
senses.exampleCN: 合同把他约束在公司三年。
senses.why: A bound person cannot move away, so obligation is described with the rope word.
senses.whyCN: 被绑住的人走不开，于是义务也用这条绳子的词来表达。

intro.en: The noun and verb both go back to Old English, where the sense of a cord or bond already covered fastening, and the sport sense of an equal score is much later.
intro.cn: 名词与动词都可追溯到古英语，当时「绳、束缚」的意思已包含捆绑之意，「比分相同」的体育义项出现很晚。

items.en: The noun teag and the verb tiegan meant a cord and to bind.
items.cn: 名词 teag 与动词 tiegan 意为「绳」和「捆绑」。

items.en: The verb covered not only ropes but any obligation that holds a person.
items.cn: 这个动词不仅指绳子，也指任何把人拴住的义务。

items.en: The word settles into the modern spelling tie and keeps both cord and bond.
items.cn: 这个词定型为现代拼写 tie，同时保留「绳索」与「纽带」两层。

items.en: The necktie sense becomes common in the nineteenth century with formal dress.
items.cn: 领带义项在十九世纪随正式着装普及。

items.en: Sports writing extends the word to an equal score and to scoring level.
items.cn: 体育报道把本词扩展到平分与追平比分。

items.en: Railway use names the sleeper that ties the rails to gauge.
items.cn: 铁路用语用本词命名把钢轨固定在轨距上的枕木。

note.en: The look-alikes share the spelling pattern of the short stem, while the near-meaning group gathers other words for binding and for drawn results.
note.cn: 形近组围绕这个短词干的拼写，近义组则收集其它表示捆绑与平局结果的词。

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the original meaning of binding, from common phrases, and from the word family.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「捆绑」的本义、常用短语与词族出发。

normal.en: Tie means to bind, so a business tie binds people just as a rope binds a boat.
normal.cn: tie 意为捆绑，所以生意上的 tie 像绳子系船一样把人绑在一起。

normal.en: Untie is un- plus tie, the prefix doing the work of loosening.
normal.cn: untie 是 un- 加 tie，前缀做的就是松开的活。

normal.en: Tie up means both to fasten and to occupy, because a tied thing cannot be used freely.
normal.cn: tie up 既指系紧也指占用，因为被绑住的东西不能自由使用。

normal.en: A tie in football ties the two scores to the same number.
normal.cn: 足球里的 tie 把两边的比分拴在同一个数上。

normal.en: The spelling change to tying keeps the y after a vowel, as in dying.
normal.cn: 变成 tying 时 y 保留在元音后，和 dying 一样。

abstract.en: Picture two loose ends pulled in opposite directions until the knot snaps tight.
abstract.cn: 想象两个松散的绳头被向反方向拉，直到结猛然收紧。

abstract.en: Think of a necktie as a rope that fashion has made polite.
abstract.cn: 把领带想成一条被时尚变得得体的绳子。

abstract.en: A draw on the scoreboard is a rope holding both teams at the same height.
abstract.cn: 记分牌上的平局就是一根把两队拉在同一高度的绳。

examples.en: He tied the parcel with brown string.
examples.cn: 他用棕色细绳把包裹捆好。

examples.en: The game ended in a tie, so both teams stayed on the field.
examples.cn: 比赛以平局结束，两队都留在了场上。

examples.en: Strong family ties helped her through the difficult year.
examples.cn: 牢固的家庭纽带帮她度过了艰难的一年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太」——绳子拉得太紧，一下就系上了。

root: 古英语 teag（绳、带）与 tiegan（捆绑）同源，属日耳曼语族固有词，与德语 Zick 无直接关系；「领带」义十九世纪成形，「平局」义来自体育报道的引申。

sensesIntro.en: From the single act of binding grow the cord, the necktie, the bond between people, the level score, and the duty that limits freedom, while the railway sleeper keeps the most literal sense.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「捆绑」这一个动作长出绳索、领带、人际纽带、平分比分与限制自由的责任，而铁路枕木保留了最字面的意思。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two ends pulled together and held by a knot.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个绳头被拉到一起，被一个结固定住。

branches.en: The physical act and its result.
branches.cn: 物理动作及其结果。

branches.en: Objects made of a binding.
branches.cn: 由系缚做成的东西。

branches.en: Binding carried into human relationships.
branches.cn: 系缚进入人际关系。

branches.en: Binding two scores level.
branches.cn: 把两个比分拴成同一水平。

branches.en: Things joined in meaning or held by duty.
branches.cn: 意义上相连或由义务拴住的事物。

intro.en: The word is native, so the affix work here is about the un- prefix and the spelling of its inflections rather than Latin roots.
intro.cn: 本词是本土词，因此这里讲的是 un- 前缀与其屈折拼写，而非拉丁词根。

latinIntro.en: No Latin original lies behind tie; the Latin items are listed only for comparison with borrowed words of similar meaning.
latinIntro.cn: tie 背后没有拉丁原词；所列拉丁词仅与近义借词作对照。

items.meaningCN: 表示「捆绑」的古英语词干
items.example: The whole word is this stem with no added ending.
items.exampleCN: 整词就是这个词干，未加任何后缀。

items.example: Untie reverses the fastening.
items.exampleCN: untie 把系上的动作反过来。

items.meaningCN: 过去式或过去分词结尾
items.example: Tied also serves as an adjective.
items.exampleCN: tied 也作形容词用。

items.example: Tying keeps a y before the ending.
items.exampleCN: tying 在词尾前保留 y。

items.example: Ties serves as plural and third person.
items.exampleCN: ties 既是复数也是第三人称单数。

items.meaning: used at the start of compounds
items.example: Tie-break names a game that settles a draw.
items.exampleCN: tie-break 指结束平局的决胜局。

items.example: A tie-clip holds a tie to a shirt.
items.exampleCN: tie-clip 把领带夹在衬衫上。

items.example: A tie-less shirt needs no necktie.
items.exampleCN: tie-less 形容不戴领带的衬衫。

definition_zh: 时间；时候；次数；时代；时机；计时；为……定时
definition_en: the continuous passage in which events happen, a particular moment or occasion, or a period of history; also to measure or schedule how long something takes
core_image: 沙漏颈口的细沙一粒粒落下，谁也停不住
scene: 老街的钟表铺里挂满大小不一的旧钟。The old clocks in the shop kept different time, each off by a minute or two.
sceneCN: 这里 time 是「（钟表所指示的）时间」（第 1 个义项：时间、时刻）；句意为店里的旧钟各走各的时间，每只都差一两分钟。画面里有钟面、指针与柜台。

pos.zh: 名词：时间；时候；次数；时代
动词：为……计时；安排……的时间

derivatives.zh: 由名词加 -ly 构成，义为「及时的」
加 -less 构成，义为「永恒的；超越时间的」
加 -ing 名词化，义为「时机把握；计时」
加 -er 构成，义为「计时器」

senses.title: The passage of time
senses.definition: the continuous progress of seconds, hours, and years in which events occur
senses.definitionCN: 事件在其中发生的秒、小时、年的连续流逝
senses.example: Time passes more slowly when you are waiting.
senses.exampleCN: 等待时时间过得格外慢。
senses.why: Old English tima named a limited or allotted period; extending it indefinitely gives the modern sense of time itself.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 tima 指一段有限、被分配的时间；把它无限延展便成了现代的「时间本身」。

senses.title: A particular moment
senses.definition: a specific point or moment at which something happens
senses.definitionCN: 某事发生的具体时刻
senses.example: It is time to go home.
senses.exampleCN: 该回家了。
senses.why: A point inside the stream of time is itself a small allotted piece of it.
senses.whyCN: 时间之流中的一处，本身就是一小段被分配的时间。

senses.title: An occasion or instance
senses.definition: one occasion on which something happens, counted with a number
senses.definitionCN: 某事发生的一次，与数词连用计数
senses.example: This is the third time she has called.
senses.exampleCN: 这是她第三次打电话来。
senses.why: Each separate span of time becomes a countable unit, so repetition is counted in times.
senses.whyCN: 每一段独立的时间成可数单位，重复便以 times 计数。

senses.title: A period of history
senses.definition: a stretch of years associated with a distinct way of life or a ruler
senses.definitionCN: 与某种生活方式或某位统治者相关的一段年代
senses.example: In Roman times the road carried soldiers and grain.
senses.exampleCN: 在罗马时代，这条路上运送着士兵与粮食。
senses.why: Large allotted spans of history are time on the grandest scale.
senses.whyCN: 历史上被划出的大段时间，是最大尺度的时间。

senses.title: A suitable moment
senses.definition: a moment favourable for a particular action
senses.definitionCN: 适合某种行动的时刻
senses.example: Now is the time to ask for help.
senses.exampleCN: 现在是求助的时机。
senses.why: If time is allotted, some of it is given for a purpose, and that purpose opens a window.
senses.whyCN: 如果时间是分配的，其中总有一段给了某个目的，那段就是窗口。

senses.title: To measure how long something takes
senses.definition: to measure or record the duration of an activity
senses.definitionCN: 测量或记录某项活动的时长
senses.example: The coach timed every runner with a stopwatch.
senses.exampleCN: 教练用秒表给每位跑者计时。
senses.why: Telling time turns the noun into the act of counting the passing units.
senses.whyCN: 读取时间把名词变成了数过单位的行为。

senses.title: To schedule at a moment
senses.definition: to arrange for something to happen at a planned moment
senses.definitionCN: 安排某事在计划好的时刻发生
senses.example: They timed the launch for early morning.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把发布会定在清早。
senses.why: To give a portion of time to an event is to decide its allotted moment.
senses.whyCN: 把一段时间分给某个事件，就是决定它被分配的时刻。

senses.title: Times of rhythm or music
senses.definition: the rhythm or speed of a piece of music, or the beat of an activity
senses.definitionCN: 乐曲的节奏或速度，也指活动的节拍
senses.example: The drummer set the time for the whole band.
senses.exampleCN: 鼓手为整个乐队定下节拍。
senses.why: Music measures time in equal beats, so the word names the very beat it counts.
senses.whyCN: 音乐以等分的拍计量时间，于是本词也被赋予它所数的那一拍。

senses.title: Times as multiplication
senses.definition: used after a number to show repeated quantity in multiplication
senses.definitionCN: 用在数字后表示乘法中的倍数
senses.example: Four times five is twenty.
senses.exampleCN: 四乘五等于二十。
senses.why: When a span repeats a number of times, counting it multiplies; hence the arithmetic sense.
senses.whyCN: 当一段时间重复若干次，计数就变成相乘，于是有了算术义。

senses.title: Time on a clock
senses.definition: the reading shown by a clock or watch
senses.definitionCN: 钟表显示的读数
senses.example: The clocks in the shop kept different time.
senses.exampleCN: 店里的钟各走各的时间。
senses.why: A clock exists to convert the invisible stream into a number we can read.
senses.whyCN: 钟表的存在就是把看不见的流动变成可读的数字。

intro.en: The English noun is native, related to words in other Germanic languages for a time or hour, and its root sense is an allotted or divided period.
intro.cn: 这个英语名词是本土词，与其它日耳曼语中表示「时间、时辰」的词同源，其根本义是「被分配、被划分的一段时间」。

items.en: Tima meant a limited period or a measured hour.
items.cn: tima 意为有限的时段或量定的时辰。

items.en: Cognates in Old Norse and Old High German also mean time or hour, pointing to a shared root.
items.cn: 古诺斯语与古高地德语中的同源词同样表示时间、时辰，指向共同词根。

items.en: The noun expands from a limited span to time in general and to counted occasions.
items.cn: 名词从有限时段扩展到一般意义的时间，以及可数的事件次数。

items.en: The verb to time, meaning to measure or schedule, is formed from the noun.
items.cn: 表示计时或安排时间的动词 time 由名词构成。

items.en: Clock and railway keeping time fix the phrase as a standard of accuracy.
items.cn: 钟表与铁路的「对时间」让这一短语成为准确性的标准。

items.en: The sense of dating from a clock, and of rhythm in music, settle as ordinary uses.
items.cn: 钟表读数义与音乐节拍义都落定为日常用法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the word family built on time, and the near-meaning group lists other words for periods and for timing.
note.cn: 形近组收集以 time 为词干构成的词族，近义组列出表示时段与计时的其他词。

entries.definition: happening at just the right moment
not affected by the passing of time
a device that measures intervals of time
a herb used in cooking, a different word
entries.definitionCN: 百里香；只是读音相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a length of time with a stated character
a long period named by its events
a very short point in time
the length of time something lasts

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the allotted-period idea, from its fixed phrases, and from the family it produced.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「被分配的时段」这一观念、固定短语与派生词族入手。

normal.en: On time and in time differ: on time is punctual, in time is early enough.
normal.cn: on time 是准时，in time 是还来得及，两者不同。

normal.en: Take your time literally means take a portion of time for yourself.
normal.cn: take your time 字面就是为自己取一段时间。

normal.en: The times of counting three times and the times of multiplying share one span repeated.
normal.cn: 三次的 times 与乘法的 times 都是同一段的重复。

normal.en: Timely, timeless, timer all grow from time with ordinary endings.
normal.cn: timely、timeless、timer 都由 time 加常规词尾构成。

normal.en: The thyme herb sounds the same but has a Greek plant name.
normal.cn: 香草 thyme 读音相同，但名字来自希腊的植物名。

abstract.en: Picture sand running without pause through the neck of a glass.
abstract.cn: 想象细沙不停从玻璃瓶颈落下。

abstract.en: Think of a clock face where hands never agree, just as in the old shop.
abstract.cn: 想一面指针永不统一的钟面，正如那家旧钟铺。

abstract.en: A meeting is a small box drawn round a piece of the day.
abstract.cn: 一场会面就是在一天里画出的小方框。

examples.en: We have enough time to walk to the station.
examples.cn: 我们有足够时间走到车站。

examples.en: The race was timed with an electronic system.
examples.cn: 比赛用电子系统计时。

examples.en: He has told the same story many times.
examples.cn: 同一个故事他讲过很多次。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太」——太久了，沙子漏完，时间也没了。

root: 古英语 tima（时段、时辰），日耳曼语族固有词，与古诺斯语、古高地德语中的同源词同义，词根义为「被划分、被分配的时间」。

sensesIntro.en: The allotted span widens into time itself, narrows into a moment, is counted as an occasion, is stretched into an era, and is measured by clocks, music, and arithmetic.
sensesIntro.cn: 被分配的时段放宽成时间本身，收窄成一个时刻，被数成次数，被拉长为时代，也被钟表、音乐与算术计量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: sand falling at an even rate through a narrow neck.
core.cn: 核心意象：细沙以均匀速度从窄颈落下。

branches.en: The flow itself, unlimited.
branches.cn: 流动本身，无穷无尽。

branches.en: A point or window singled out of the flow.
branches.cn: 从流中挑出的点或窗口。

branches.en: The span counted and repeated.
branches.cn: 被计数、被重复的时段。

branches.en: Long spans and rhythmic beats.
branches.cn: 长的时代与有节拍的拍子。

branches.en: The measurement and scheduling of time.
branches.cn: 对时间的计量与安排。

intro.en: The native noun takes a set of ordinary English endings and compounds, which is the main affix story here.
intro.cn: 这个本土名词接一串常规英语词尾与复合成分，这就是这里的构词主线。

latinIntro.en: Time has no Latin etymon; the borrowed Latin items below are ordinary companions in technical writing about time.
latinIntro.cn: time 没有拉丁词源；下面的拉丁词是时间类技术写作中常见的借词。

items.example: The root sense survives in the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 整个词族都保留这一词根义。

items.example: Timely means at the right time.
items.exampleCN: timely 意为在恰当时间。

items.example: Timeless means without time.
items.exampleCN: timeless 意为无时间。

items.example: Timing is the skill of choosing the moment.
items.exampleCN: timing 指把握时机的技巧。

items.example: A timer measures intervals.
items.exampleCN: timer 计量间隔。

items.example: A timetable arranges a school day.
items.exampleCN: timetable 安排学校的日程。

items.example: Times serves as plural and verb form.
items.exampleCN: times 既是复数也是动词形式。

items.meaning: working only part of the week
items.example: Part-time work leaves hours free.
items.exampleCN: part-time 的工作会空出若干小时。
